notes: Added Galway City Museum – immersive redevelopment and expansion as a 98% confidence Pitch. Construction started on 7 September 2026 on the €19m project, backed by €12.6m from Fáilte Ireland, and the funded visitor proposition explicitly includes immersive exhibition spaces, interactive storytelling and digital technology.

Carey Building Contractors is already appointed for the main works, so the useful route is downstream specialist delivery rather than general construction. Watch next for exhibition/interpretation design, digital-media, AV/systems integration and exhibit-fabrication appointments, and determine whether packages are council-direct or routed through the main contractor.

Reviewed the Museum of the Future's current full-gallery reinvention. The museum is now closed and plans to reopen in Q1 2027 with a completely reimagined, highly interactive experience, but no evidence of an unassigned specialist procurement package was found, so it was not added as a lead.

Reviewed the National Museum of Finland reopening digital-exhibition procurement. The official tender closed on 7 September 2026, so it was not introduced as a new current opportunity from general research.
